normalisation: Reuse the original training-only channel statistics fitted on the common 5,888-point coverage.
reservoir: Existing 300-node weights and bias reused within each fold/seed; alpha=1; warmup=10; ESN mean state and LSM mean spikes.
selection: Per-model, per-fold mean validation sweep accuracy over five seeds; ties: validation window accuracy, then 128,64,256. Integer counts used.
test_use: Choices frozen after all validation jobs; test alternatives reported as retrospective sensitivity, never used for selection. Existing L128 predictions reused.
training_budget: CNN epochs and batch size fixed; samples per epoch equal, while numbers of windows and optimiser updates change with L.
matching: One original training sweep per class; nearest reference by mean squared distance over 5,888 ordered, training-standardised four-channel samples; no fitted hyperparameters.
evaluation: Sweep-level majority vote for window models; smallest class index breaks ties. Means and population SD over three fold means after seed averaging.
study_status: Additional retrospective analysis of existing acquisitions; original main results retained.
